segments.scene_heading: 4-1 Day | Ext. Garden of the wedding venue
segments.first_state: Camera on the aisle in front of the white wooden wedding arch, on the rose-bush side. Natalie, in her ivory bridal gown and short veil, stands under the centre of the arch, holding the one bouquet loosely at her waist and staring at Sebastian. Sebastian, in his black tuxedo, stands beside her under the arch on the boxwood-hedge side, facing her. George, in his charcoal suit, stands beside Natalie under the arch on the rose-bush side, facing down the aisle. The Officiant stands at the centre of the arch just behind the couple, hands clasped, facing down the aisle. Cassie, in her scarlet satin cocktail dress, stands at the head of the aisle a step in front of Natalie on the rose-bush side, holding the one empty white gift box with its lid off. Lauren, in her lilac sheath dress with a small handbag on her arm, stands at the head of the aisle against the front-row chair on the boxwood-hedge side. Two short rows of white folding chairs flank the petal aisle. Natalie's phone lies face up on the seat of the front-row chair on the rose-bush side. On the boxwood-hedge side of the lawn stands one small round white high cocktail table with one silver tray; Guest 1 stands at it on the arch side and Guest 2 on the aisle side, each holding a champagne flute, and Guest 1's pink phone is in the silver clutch under her arm.

shots.camera: Wide shot, slow push in from the aisle toward the arch, eye-level, from the rose-bush side
shots.visual: Natalie, bouquet at her waist, faces Sebastian under the flower-hung arch, with George beside her on the rose-bush side and the Officiant behind them. Cassie, a step in front of Natalie, tips the empty white gift box toward her with a smirk; Lauren stands against the front-row chair on the hedge side, and Guest 1 and Guest 2 watch from the cocktail table by the hedge with their flutes.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Cassie, in English, sugary and mocking): {Nothing. Just like your husband's bank account.}

shots.camera: Medium shot, locked-off camera, eye-level, from the rose-bush side of the aisle
shots.visual: Lauren, leaning against the front-row chair on the hedge side, looks Natalie up and down and arches a brow; behind her, out of focus, Guest 1 and Guest 2 stand at the cocktail table with their flutes.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Lauren, in English, icy drawl): {A rented dress and a broke groom. At least they match.}

shots.camera: Medium close-up, clean single framed tight on face and shoulders, locked-off camera, eye-level
shots.visual: Natalie, under the arch, turns her head toward Lauren and holds her stepmother's eyes with a level, cold gaze.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Natalie, in English, quiet and cutting): {You picked him.}

shots.camera: Medium shot, over-the-shoulder shot from behind Natalie's shoulder, eye-level
shots.visual: Sebastian, on the hedge side of the arch, leans slightly toward Natalie with a lazy, amused half-smile, the back of Natalie's veil in the foreground.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Sebastian, in English, low and teasing): {Don't worry. My family doesn't like me either.}

shots.camera: Medium shot, locked-off camera, eye-level, Sebastian's shoulder at one frame edge and George's arm at the other
shots.visual: Natalie, bouquet still at her waist, looks up at Sebastian and a small smile breaks across her face.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Natalie, in English, dry and warm): {Good. One less family to impress.}

shots.camera: Medium shot, slight low angle, locked-off camera, the arch drapes framing him
shots.visual: The Officiant, hands clasped, looks from Natalie to Sebastian; their shoulders show at both frame edges.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Officiant, in English, measured and ceremonial): {Natalie, Sebastian. Are you both ready to marry?}

shots.camera: Close-up, clean single on her face, locked-off camera, eye-level
shots.visual: Natalie lifts her chin and gives a firm nod, her eyes steady.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Natalie, in English, firm): {Yes.}

shots.camera: Medium close-up, clean single, slow push in on Sebastian, eye-level
shots.visual: Sebastian glances past Natalie toward Cassie and Lauren at the head of the aisle, then back at her with a sly grin.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Sebastian, in English, lazy murmur): {Let's give them something to hate.}

shots.camera: Medium shot, locked-off camera, eye-level, from the aisle on the rose-bush side
shots.visual: The Officiant opens his clasped hands toward the couple, with Natalie and Sebastian at the frame edges.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Officiant, in English, warm and resonant): {Then I pronounce you married.}

shots.camera: Medium shot, three-shot under the arch, handheld camera, eye-level
shots.visual: Sebastian offers Natalie his open hand. Natalie pushes the bouquet into George's hands beside her, ignores Sebastian's hand, grabs his satin lapels and pulls him close.
shots.audio: <Fabric rustles>

shots.camera: Close-up, slow orbit around the couple on the aisle side, starting on Natalie's profile and ending on Sebastian's, eye-level
shots.visual: Natalie and Sebastian share a brief kiss under the white roses, her hands still holding his lapels.
shots.audio: <A few guests gasp softly>

shots.camera: Medium shot, locked-off camera, eye-level, from the rose-bush side of the aisle
shots.visual: Cassie, in front of the arch on the rose-bush side, lowers the gift box and stares with her lips parted, and Lauren, against the front-row chair on the hedge side, stiffens.

segments.light_audio: High sunlight from the rose-bush side gives warm, soft highlights; the white drapes glow. Live sound: birdsong, leaves rustling, faint murmurs from the guests.

shots.camera: Medium shot, handheld camera following Cassie from in front of Natalie to Sebastian's side, eye-level, from the rose-bush side of the aisle
shots.visual: Cassie steps past the front of Natalie to Sebastian's hedge side under the arch and reaches for his arm with a seductive smile, the empty gift box in her other hand; Natalie and the Officiant stand behind them.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Cassie, in English, sing-song and flirty): {Didn't know you could do that. Want to try with the prettier sister?}

shots.camera: Medium shot, three-shot, locked-off camera, eye-level
shots.visual: Sebastian steps back out of Cassie's reach to Natalie's side and glances at Natalie; Cassie's hand closes on air and she backs off toward Lauren at the front-row chair on the hedge side.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Sebastian, in English, unhurried): {I already did.}

shots.camera: Medium shot, locked-off camera, eye-level
shots.visual: At the cocktail table by the hedge, Guest 2 laughs into her champagne glass while Guest 1 beside her, flute in hand, covers a grin.
shots.audio: <A stifled laugh, a glass clinks>

shots.camera: Close-up, clean single on her face, locked-off camera, eye-level
shots.visual: Cassie's smile drops; she flushes and glares toward the cocktail table, her fingers tightening on the gift box.

shots.camera: Medium shot, locked-off camera, eye-level, Sebastian's shoulder at one frame edge and George's arm at the other
shots.visual: Natalie, under the arch, turns toward Lauren at the front-row chair on the hedge side and holds out her palm; George beside her grips the bouquet.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Natalie, in English, steely): {Wedding's over, Lauren. Where's the money?}

shots.camera: Close-up insert, locked-off camera, eye-level
shots.visual: Lauren's hands clutch her small handbag tight against her hip, her diamond ring flashing.

shots.camera: Medium shot, locked-off camera, eye-level, from the rose-bush side of the aisle, Cassie's shoulder at the frame edge
shots.visual: Lauren, against the front-row chair on the hedge side with Cassie now beside her, lifts her chin with a thin, dismissive smile.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Lauren, in English, clipped and cold): {We'll discuss that later.}

shots.camera: Medium shot, slight low angle, slow push in on Sebastian, eye-line toward the head of the aisle
shots.visual: Sebastian steps up beside Natalie, still on her boxwood-hedge side, and fixes his eyes on Lauren.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Sebastian, in English, calm and commanding): {Fifty thousand. You promised. Pay her.}

shots.camera: Medium shot, locked-off camera, eye-level, Lauren's shoulder at the frame edge
shots.visual: Cassie, beside Lauren at the front-row chair, folds her arms over the gift box and tilts her head with a sneer.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Cassie, in English, mocking valley-girl lilt): {Already begging? You two really are perfect together.}

shots.camera: Medium close-up, clean single, locked-off camera, eye-level
shots.visual: Sebastian smiles lazily, his steel-grey eyes moving from Cassie to Lauren.
shots.audio: Dialogue (Sebastian, in English, smooth and amused): {Funny. You're the ones who can't afford to keep your word.}

shots.camera: Medium shot, locked-off camera, eye-level, from the rose-bush side of the aisle
shots.visual: Lauren's jaw tightens against the front-row chair, and Cassie beside her shoots a glare toward the arch.
